verdict: Organic reach is softening across all three locations; blockers are being cleared.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, all engagement this period came from unpaid sources — combined Google Business Profile actions totalled 348 across 28 days, with zero paid spend active. Organic visibility softened late in the period: Search Console clicks fell 50% week-over-week at Forte, 52% at Advance Grinding, and 42% at O'Hare, with the sharpest drops concentrated in the final days of September. The root cause ties to a web and SEO fix that has been overdue since August 31, alongside CRM and outreach milestones that are now being prioritised for resolution. Site reindexing and outreach sequences are both targeted for completion by October 31, after which organic signals and first contact volume should begin to recover.
